caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical container, resembling a pottery jar or crock, positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The jar is rendered in shades of brown and ochre with subtle variations that suggest a glazed ceramic surface. The rim of the jar is slightly wider and features a distinct rounded lip, with the opening showing an interior shaded in darker brown and hints of greenish hues. The body of the jar exhibits horizontal lines and mottled texture indicative of hand-crafted pottery. There are no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Eardley Jar
